inputs.label: Public cfDNA insert-size QC
inputs.prompt: Summarize the insert-size distribution of this public paired-end human BAM and report the observation count, mode, median, 90-150 bp fraction, and fraction above 250 bp.

inputs.label: Simplex UMI consensus wrapper
inputs.prompt: Run the bundled preprocess_cfdna() wrapper on a paired-end inline-UMI uBAM using the documented 6M11S+T read structure and the simplex path.

inputs.label: Duplex UMI consensus wrapper
inputs.prompt: Run the bundled preprocess_cfdna() wrapper on reciprocal paired UMIs with duplex=True and produce a filtered, indexed consensus BAM.

inputs.label: Flag-contaminated fragment QC
inputs.prompt: Run insert_size_qc() on a BAM containing ordinary primary reads plus secondary, supplementary, duplicate, and QC-fail records, and verify that the advertised primary-fragment QC population is enforced.

inputs.label: Manual recipe and path robustness
inputs.prompt: Execute the documented fgbio/bwa/samtools recipe, including paths containing spaces, and verify UMI extraction, BAM-to-alignment conversion, tag transfer, consensus filtering order, and final indexed output.
